description: the words of the subsystem detjob in an event row of a scan job bucket (the open place of the Platform family events-unit — the root of the row); the field type is set by the writing lesson — V/05.3 N1.3 (the teaching tick in media time), V/05.4 N1.2, N1.4 (scan.partial — when waited or fetch_waited runs out); the fields of other models — the worker's registry, not judged by the family; read by the console (as is) and the auto scenarios (V/07.2 N1.3 — strictly)

pass.description: the number k of the look on the interval grid, a multiple of 3 (V/05.3 N1.3)

partial.description: what was not waited for — the same elements as partial of the result: <volume>@<server> and device:<from>-<to> (V/05.4 N1.2, N1.4)

waited.description: the value of the counter waited or fetch_waited that ran out, accumulated seconds; both ran out — the larger (V/05.4 N1.2, N1.4)
